messages:
carla_cs: Kickoff — ZephyrCorp dedicated bring-up planning. Goal: final quota commit, autoscale targets, and two staged load windows next Tue/Wed. Need signoff on burst policy and failover route. @amit_se can you confirm model shard sizes?
amit_se: Got it. Will validate shard mapping by EOD. Current plan uses p4d-8x for heavy traffic + g4dn for background. Expect per-GPU qps: ~850 for short sequences.
linda_sre: For autoscale, recommend: min_instances=2, target_cpu=65%, scale_step=1, cooldown=120s. Also add a cold-cache grace of 10m on first warmup window.
devon_ops: Noted. I'll prepare a runbook snippet for ops play:
devon_ops: ```steps:
1) pre-warm KV cache with prefix task (see runbook)
2) apply traffic-shift policy (10% -> 50% -> 90%) every 10m
3) monitor p99 latency and error-rate
4) rollback to fallback model if >=5% errors for 5m
```
carla_cs: Perfect. Two questions: (1) quota — Zephyr asked for 1.2M tokens/day guaranteed, with burst to 2.5M for 3 hours. Can we map that to reserved units? (2) Load windows: 09:00-11:00 and 21:00-23:00 PST — okay to do warmup in the prior hour?
edward_csm: Customer is fine with warmup hour. They prefer the evening window to be the high-traffic test. Also flagged data residency check — they need logs kept in eu-central for that cluster.
amit_se: Quota mapping: recommend commit = 1.25M tokens/day (round up) on reserved pool + policy for burst via burst_pool with throttle bucket: rate=1200 rps, burst=40k tokens. I'll drop exact YAML to the doc.
linda_sre: EU logs — set log-ship target to eu-central S3 and retention=90d. I'll add a routing tag so metrics pipeline doesn't mix with other customers.
opsbot: deploy-bot: scheduled job created — "zephyr-warmup-svc" kickoff at 2026-03-24T08:00:00Z. CI checks: infra-health=ok, model-compat=ok.
devon_ops: Load test plan (quick):
devon_ops: ```bash
# use k6-like tool, ramping stages
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 10m --out json=evening-window.json script.js
# script.js will hit /v1/redwood/generate with 60% payload of typical prompt
```
carla_cs: Can someone own rollback criteria? I propose: p50>500ms OR p99>1200ms OR error_rate>1% for 3 consecutive minutes -> immediate 50% traffic shift to fallback model and open incident channel.
linda_sre: I'll own monitoring and automated shift hook. Will add metrics thresholds to the alerting rule and a runbook link.
amit_se: I'll provide the exact shard config and quantized model variant for fallback by tomorrow morning.
edward_csm: I'll send the customer the final schedule and SLA rundown after you all confirm. They asked if we can do a short dry-run on Friday at 14:00 PST at 25% traffic; thumbs up?
carla_cs: Yes please — schedule dry-run and tag me. Thanks everyone :rocket: 
devon_ops: Scheduling dry-run now. Patch note: reduced cold-start penalty by preloading KV prefixes.
opsbot: reminder-bot: dry-run scheduled on 2026-03-20T21:00:00Z for channel customer-success.
carla_cs: Closing loop — next steps: Amit (shard/quotas YAML), Linda (alerts + EU log config), Devon (runbook + k6 script), Edward (customer comms). We'll reconvene Thu EOD if any blockers.
amit_se: On it.
linda_sre: Roger.
devon_ops: Copy that.
edward_csm: Will draft email and ping when sent.
carla_cs: Thanks all.
